Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Object, s As String, path As String, calc As Long
    calc = Application.Calculation
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
    path = folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx"
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
    Case 1
        ws.EnableFormatConditionsCalculation = False
    Case 2
        ws.EnableFormatConditionsCalculation = False: ws.EnableFormatConditionsCalculation = True
    Case 3
        ws.EnableFormatConditionsCalculation = 0
    Case 4
        ws.EnableFormatConditionsCalculation = "False"
    Case 5
        ws.EnableFormatConditionsCalculation = Null
    Case 6
        ws.EnableFormatConditionsCalculation = "abc"
    Case 7
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual: ws.EnableFormatConditionsCalculation = False
    End Select
    s = "ok|" & ws.EnableFormatConditionsCalculation
Saved:
    Application.Calculation = calc
    wb.SaveAs path, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
    s = s & "|" & wb.Worksheets(1).EnableFormatConditionsCalculation
    wb.Close False
    Tried = s
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 7
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
